{{Quote|Your future lies in the alchemy of flesh. I saw it in you the moment we met, and nothing has dissuaded me from that. It is a talent, for some, that lies on the edges of acceptability. It is a strong, challenging power, and you must be firmly balanced to attempt it. You must not let heavier desires tempt you. The dark side lurks close to what I do here, Lanoree, and I am always vigilant. Don't be tempted. Don't be drawn. Maintain your balance.|[[Dam-Powl]], to Lanoree Brock|<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>}}
The '''alchemy of flesh''' was a [[Je'daii]] form of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]] practiced at [[Anil Kesh]], the [[Je'daii Temples|Temple]] of Science.<ref name="Adventures of Lanoree">"[[The Adventures of Lanoree Brock, Je'daii Ranger]]"</ref> The [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] studied the practice in her spare [[Time/Legends|time]] under the guidance of [[Je'daii Master|Master]] [[Dam-Powl]]. In a compartment of her [[Peacemaker-class cruiser|Peacemaker starship]], Brock was working on crafting a living being from cells. Checking on it, she noticed that [[Blood/Legends|blood]] dribbled from forming veins, vestigial limbs flapped around and it had milky eyes. Brock had created it from her own flesh. In the early stages, it had no mind and Lanoree wondered if it could feel pain.<ref name="Into the Void" />
